item.title: Western Cape school admissions policy fails the test
item.description: The Western Cape Education Department must develop a comprehensive management plan for late and transfer applications within six months, following a court ruling that its admissions policy violates the Constitution.

item.title: Gqeberha schoolboy dies during rugby practice
item.description: Seventeen-year-old Kungawoo Booi went to rugby practice on Thursday, but the session ended in tragedy when he was injured on the field and died.

item.title: Is Eben Etzebeth’s 12-week ban a fair punishment?
item.description: Eben Etzebeth’s 12-week ban for eye-gouging during the Springboks’ match against Wales has sparked debate over its fairness, following an initial 18-week sentence reduced by six weeks due to his good disciplinary record. Picture: Anne-Christine Poujoulat/AFP

item.title: New blood for Bafana as AFCON squad sees major transformation ahead of Morocco
item.description: Themba Zwane was left out of Bafana Bafana's Africa Cup of Nations squad by head coach Hugo Broos.

item.description: Limpopo farmer Attie Mahne, 77, was killed in a brutal farm attack in Tolwe; his wife Pietro was assaulted but managed to raise the alarm.

item.description: Russia's President Vladimir Putin is welcomed by Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi upon the Russian leader's arrival at Palam Air Force Base in New Delhi on December 4, 2025, the first day of his two-day state visit to India.
